entities.name: Zosimos
entities.description: An adventurer on Theros who worries about never earning the gods' favor, is taught by a satyr, and receives a god-forged sword.

entities.name: Satyr
entities.description: An unnamed stout satyr; included here as the page's unnamed guide who teaches Zosimos and gives him a dull knife that becomes a shining sword.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Zosimos adventures.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god whose favor heroes desire.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god whose favor heroes desire.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A god whose favor heroes desire.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The dark god to whom worry is a form of worship.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god whose virulent poison is compared to worry.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Underworld who coveted the world of the living and forbade return without a dire price.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The city Zosimos had been heading to.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm where coinsmiths mint ostraka from the clay funerary masks of the dead.

events.summary: Walking a path, Zosimos is troubled by fear of never achieving glory or the gods' favor.
events.quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

events.summary: A stout satyr hops onto the path and offers Zosimos lessons on being a hero.
events.quote: asked if Zosimos wanted to be a hero, then offered to give him lessons on being heroic

events.summary: The satyr teaches that worry is Phenax's creation and that worrying is a form of worship of him.
events.quote: Worrying was a form of worship of Phenax

events.summary: The satyr lets Zosimos taste nectarvine sap and says creation is a garden people miss by chasing glory.
events.quote: the whole creation is a garden

events.summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a dull, rusty knife and skips away into the woods.
events.quote: Zosimos took the blade out of politeness and stuck it in his belt.

events.summary: Zosimos finds peace and, instead of going to Meletis, turns toward distant eastern mountains.
events.quote: He had been heading to Meletis , but after the encounter with the satyr, something in him had shifted.

events.summary: The satyr's dagger turns into a shining sword forged by the gods.
events.quote: He looked down to see that the satyr's dagger had become a shining sword, one forged by the gods .

relations.quote: then offered to give him lessons on being heroic
